statement: Rebuilding to 40 miles a week after jaw surgery, back to running Tuesday through Friday and Sunday, with the erg and two lift days carrying the fitness while my legs catch up.

liftPhases.name: Re-entry
liftPhases.rule: RPE 6, two reps left in every set. Exhale on the way up, no breath holds or bracing grinds, jaw relaxed and teeth apart.

sessions.name: Heavy A
moves: Farmer carry, 3 × 40 m @ 35 lb each hand

liftPhases.name: Rebuild
liftPhases.rule: RPE 7. Breathe out through the hard part of each rep. Still no maxes and no grinding.

sessions.name: Heavy A
moves: 45° back extension, 3 × 12 holding a 10 lb plate
Farmer carry, 3 × 40 m @ 44 lb each hand

liftPhases.name: Build
liftPhases.rule: RPE 7 to 8. Down weeks: drop one set from everything.

sessions.name: Heavy A
moves: 45° back extension, 3 × 12 holding a 25 lb plate

weeks.content: **Week 4 after surgery.** Cleared for exercise, so this block is about ramping, not permission. Flat, soft, conversational running. Rows stay steady while the running restarts. Lifts at about 60% of normal, RPE 6, exhale through every rep and keep the jaw loose. Still blowing the nose softly, so no breath holds or bearing down on anything.

days.title: Rest + PT
days.content:
Rest from running and rowing. PT only.

**PT, 15 min:**
- Step-downs, 2 × 10 per side
- Wall sit, 3 × 45 to 60 s
- SL glute bridge, 2 × 12 per side

days.title: Easy run + Heavy A
days.content:
**Run:** 2 miles, ~50 ft. Flat and soft, a park loop or the waterfront. Run 4 min, walk 1 min if the knee says anything. Conversational pace, which will feel too slow. That’s right.

**Heavy A (hinge + pull):** after the run, or later the same day.
- RDL, 3 × 8 @ 75 to 95 lb
- Chest-supported DB row, 3 × 10 @ 25 to 30 lb
- 45° back extension, 2 × 12, bodyweight
- Hammer curl, 2 × 12 @ 20 lb
- Farmer carry, 3 × 40 m @ 35 lb each hand
- Dead bug, 2 × 8 per side
RPE 6, two reps left in every set. Exhale on the way up, no breath holds or bracing grinds, jaw relaxed and teeth apart.

days.title: Steady row, 20 min
days.content:
**Row:** 20 min steady at 20 spm, conversational effort. Watch meters per stroke (9.16 on Oct 22) and pace will follow. Jaw loose at the catch, no gritting on the drive, sit tall instead of leaning back past 11 o’clock (that lean is the sore mid back).

**PT, 15 min:**
- Step-downs, 2 × 10 per side
- Wall sit, 3 × 45 to 60 s
- SL glute bridge, 2 × 12 per side

days.title: Easy run + Heavy B
days.content:
**Run:** 2 miles, ~50 ft. Flat and soft, a park loop or the waterfront. Run 4 min, walk 1 min if the knee says anything. Conversational pace, which will feel too slow. That’s right.

- Goblet squat, 3 × 10 @ 35 lb
- SL RDL, 3 × 8 per side @ 25 lb
- Step-downs, 3 × 10 per side, bodyweight
- KB swing, 3 × 12 @ 35 lb
- Dead hang, 3 × 20 s
- Pallof press, 2 × 10 per side
RPE 6, two reps left in every set. Exhale on the way up, no breath holds or bracing grinds, jaw relaxed and teeth apart.

Thanksgiving Thursday. Run in the morning, lift Friday if the day gets eaten.
